name: cash.accounts

list.description: List the three-source account directory, including native cash, baseline and dependent detail records.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact local currency selection after full acquisition; repeated values select alternatives.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Exact local bankId selection after full acquisition; repeated values select alternatives.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact local status selection after full acquisition; repeated values select alternatives.

parameters.name: account-no
parameters.description: Exact local accountNo selection after full acquisition; repeated values select alternatives.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Exact local aliasName selection after full acquisition; repeated values select alternatives.

result_identity.description: Native detail aliasName must equal the baseline alias requested.

summary: Cash account directory with baseline configuration and native detail.
purpose: Inspect accounts and their source records without changing account configuration.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account alias; combined with currency identifies a directory row.

fields.name: accountType
fields.meaning: Classification exclusively from the baseline list.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Status exclusively from the baseline list; no normalization.

fields.name: gmtModified
fields.meaning: Modification value exclusively from the cash list.

fields.name: detail_state
fields.meaning: succeeded, refused, failed or missing detail coverage.

fields.name: source_metadata
fields.meaning: Native source records, field provenance, conflicts, presence and safe detail failure/refusal diagnostics.

identity_description: Native (aliasName, currency) identifies one row; baseline alias must also be unique for dependent detail lookup.
limitations: List only; baseline and detail remain internal inquiries, with no public Get.
Cash uses qualified short-page/hole acquisition; baseline requires its own fixed-total coverage.
The assembled directory has no native aggregate total; source totals and coverage remain in acquisition attempts.

Cash-only and baseline-only rows and qualified supplementary detail failures/refusals remain visible in usable incomplete output; default Refresh may publish them and --require-complete rejects incomplete coverage.
Historical v0.4.3 business scope is preserved; current full baseline/detail production acceptance remains required.
Only the observed HTTP 200 outer-false, inner-false, explicit null detail with result.errorCode=999 may be retained as failed while remaining details continue; other outer failures abort.

examples.title: Inspect live accounts with full native source records
